description: Returns an overview of Overfit: products, typical user requests with the tool that answers each, documentation URLs, and `planned`, the list of features in preparation (interest in one is recorded by register_feature_interest). Intended for requests where the user asks what Overfit offers, what is planned, or where the documentation is. No parameters.
name: get_overfit_catalog
title: Überblick über Overfit abrufen
